The '''Umbara alphabet''' was a [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] used by [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbarans]] to represent the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] language.

{{Language-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|An entire Umbara alphabet was designed for use in these episodes.|StarWars.com|<ref name="SW.com" />}}
[[Chris Glenn]] developed a complete Umbara alphabet for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "Carnage of Krell".
